name: Colour Science for Python
role: Python colour-science library for conversions, models and colour-difference analysis
notes: 2026-11-15: Triage: assess; colour difference and transfer-function calculations may support measurable palette and delivery checks. Revisit after mapping its functions to a concrete VCR check and scope.
2026-11-15: Skill opportunity: further research first; define which colour checks VCR needs and how to interpret model outputs before writing a guide.
summary: Python package with colour-space conversions, appearance models, spectral data, colour-difference functions, transfer functions and LUT operations. Its breadth supports technical colour calculations beyond palette manipulation, but a specific VCR colour conformance check and its tolerances are not yet defined.
use_when: Calculate colour differences or conversions with named colour-science models
Work with spectral data, appearance models or transfer functions in Python
Use a broader scientific API than a lightweight colour manipulation library
avoid_when: Use color.js for JavaScript colour conversion and interpolation in a web scene
Use a dedicated image tool when the task is visual grading rather than numeric analysis

assessment.rationale: PyPI lists 0.4.7 (2025-12-06) under BSD-3-Clause; the official project documents extensive colour models, datasets and calculations. Recent repository activity is visible, but a VCR measurement workflow and tolerances remain undefined.
